# Effect: multiband_compressor

Multiband compressor: splits into low, mid and high bands compressed separately, so heavy lows don't pull down the highs.

**Where to put it**: For mastering on the master bus, drum bus and bass; low_hz / high_hz are the crossover points. low_db / mid_db / high_db are the per-band makeup gains and can also work as a coarse EQ. Put it before the limiter.

Latest parameters: `muser effects multiband_compressor` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `low_hz` | 200 | 20 – 2000 Hz | Crossover point between the low and mid bands |
| `high_hz` | 2000 | 200 – 16000 Hz | Crossover point between the mid and high bands (must be above low_hz) |
| `threshold_db` | -20 | -60 – 0 dB | Threshold shared by all three bands |
| `ratio` | 3 | 1 – 100 :1 | Ratio shared by all three bands. 2-3 mastering; 4+ tighter |
| `attack_ms` | 10 | 0.01 – 1000 ms | Attack time |
| `release_ms` | 150 | 1 – 5000 ms | Release time |
| `low_db` | 0 | -24 – 24 dB | Makeup gain for the low band |
| `mid_db` | 0 | -24 – 24 dB | Makeup gain for the mid band |
| `high_db` | 0 | -24 – 24 dB | Makeup gain for the high band |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "multiband_compressor", "threshold_db": -18, "ratio": 2.5, "high_db": 1 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Light mastering squeeze (before the limiter)

  ```json
  {"type": "multiband_compressor", "threshold_db": -18, "ratio": 2, "attack_ms": 20, "release_ms": 200}
  ```

- Drum bus: tame the lows, brighten the highs

  ```json
  {"type": "multiband_compressor", "low_hz": 150, "high_hz": 4000, "threshold_db": -24, "ratio": 4, "high_db": 2}
  ```

- Bass: compress only the low-frequency boom

  ```json
  {"type": "multiband_compressor", "low_hz": 120, "high_hz": 1500, "threshold_db": -22, "ratio": 4}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- The advantage over an ordinary compressor: when the kick hits, the cymbals are not pushed down with it.
- low_db / mid_db / high_db are the per-band makeup gains, and can also be used as a very wide three-band EQ.
- Order on the master bus: eq -> multiband_compressor -> limiter.
